{{recipe}}
{{see also|Cookbook:Tres Leches Cake II}}

==Ingredients==

=== Sponge cake ===
*5 [[Cookbook:Egg|eggs]], yolks and whites separated
*1 [[Cookbook:Cup|cup]] white [[Cookbook:Granulated Sugar|granulated sugar]]
*1 [[Cookbook:Tablespoon|tbsp]] [[Cookbook:Vanilla|vanilla]]
*1 cup [[Cookbook:Self-rising Flour|self rising flour]]

=== Milk mixture ===
*1 can [[Cookbook:Sweetened Condensed Milk|sweetened condensed milk]]
*1 can [[Cookbook:Evaporated milk|evaporated milk]]
*1½ cup heavy whipping [[Cookbook:Cream|cream]]
*1 tbsp vanilla

=== Meringue ===
*3 egg whites
*1 cup white granulated sugar
*½ [[Cookbook:Teaspoon|tsp]] [[Cookbook:Cream of Tartar|cream of tartar]] (optional but used for stabilizing the egg whites; increasing their heat tolerance and volume)

==Procedure==

=== Sponge cake ===
#Preheat [[Cookbook:Oven|oven]] to 350°F. Grease and flour [[Cookbook:Cake Pan|cake pan]].
#Using a standing mixer with the whisk attachment, whip egg whites until frothy: Slowly bring the mixer to the fastest speed, stopping for a minute on each speed.
#Slowly beat in the sugar and vanilla.
#Mix in the egg yolks, and finally the flour.
#Transfer [[Cookbook:Batter|batter]] to prepared cake pan, and [[Cookbook:Baking|bake]] for 20 minutes in the preheated oven.
#Remove cake and let cool to room temperature. Poke several holes in the cake.

=== Milk mixture ===
#Combine the condensed milk, evaporated milk, cream, and vanilla.
#Heat for 5 minutes, stirring constantly. The idea is just to bring all the flavors together, so don’t overheat the milk.
#Let the milk mixture cool to room temperature.
#Slowly pour the milk mixture over the cake. Since you greased the cake pan the milk will flow around and under the cake. The cake will absorb most of the milk.

=== Meringue ===
#Place the egg whites in the bowl of a stand mixer fitted with the whisk attachment.
#Slowly bring the mixer to the fastest speed stopping for a minute or so on each speed.
#Add the cream of tartar.
#Slowly beat in the granulated sugar.

=== Assembly ===

# Spread the meringue on top of the cake.
# Use a [[Cookbook:Blowtorch|blowtorch]] or the oven [[Cookbook:Broiler|broiler]] to gently toast the meringue. Once the meringue starts to change color you have a few seconds before it burns, so stay alert.

==Notes, tips, and variations==

* It is very important to separate the eggs correctly when making the meringue. If the yolk breaks and your egg whites contain drops of yolk, the meringue will not form correctly.

== See also ==
*[[Cookbook:Tres Leches Cake II]]
